::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-buggy"}
The Buggy is a scrap-plated car with a machine gun, and Grubstake's scout. One circling your base just outside turret range is looking for something unguarded, and the next raid goes where it went. Where a buggy is killed, the next one keeps further away.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-shotgun-hand"}
The Shotgun hand is Grubstake's basic soldier: heavy armor, a pump shotgun and a set of wrenches. Hands do the looting. They walk up to machines no turret covers, take them apart and carry them home, and fight only at close range. A gun turret at each outpost keeps them off.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-harrier"}
The Scrap drone is a small flier built from salvage, with a light gun. Alone it is weak; Grubstake sends them in swarms over walls, cliffs and water, at lone poles and machines. Gun turrets shoot them down. Flamethrower turrets cannot.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-slug"}
The Slug buggy trades the buggy's machine gun for a heavy slug gun and adds armor at the front. It fires slowly, which is fine against tanks, whose armor the slug pierces, and poor against infantry. Send troopers at it, not tanks.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-sapper"}
The Dynamite sapper throws sticks of dynamite from beyond shotgun range. The blast covers a few tiles and does not hurt Grubstake's own units, so sappers fight right among the Shotgun hands. Keep your squads spread out.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-scavenger"}
The Bomb drone is a Scrap drone with its gun swapped for an explosive charge. It flies straight at one target, usually an artillery turret, a mortar or a radar, and blows up when it gets there. A gun turret beside each artillery turret stops it; a flak turret stops it sooner.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-dozer"}
The Dozer is an armored hauler with a blade. It cannot hurt units, but it rams walls open for the Shotgun hands behind it. Rocket troopers and battle tanks stop it. A second wall behind the first makes it do the job again under fire.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-flak-buggy"}
The Flak buggy is a buggy with a turret that fires scrap flak. The bursts shred drones and combat robots but barely hurt anything on the ground. Keep your fliers back and send ground units.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-scorcher"}
The Flame tank is an old tank hull with a flamethrower and a machine gun. The machine gun does most of the fighting; the flamethrower fires in short bursts, then has to refill. Fire does not harm it, but it has to get close to use it, so hit it with rockets and artillery on the way in.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-howitzer-truck"}
Grubstake's Howitzer truck is Kessler-Hayashi's model, bought second-hand, and only a camp that landed with a grudge has one. It comes out against walls that robots keep mending, to shell the roboports behind them. Your artillery outranges it and engages it on its own.
:::

::: {.unit unit="lp-grubstake-hauler"}
The Hauler does Grubstake's heavy work: it builds new lots, carries loot home, hauls ore from the claims and parks beside your belts to skim them. A destroyed hauler drops its load. Cut the road between a claim and its camp: a claim with no ore coming home lapses, and its drills are yours to take.
:::
